svg.title: A responder opens related telemetry
svg.desc: Restrict the monitor to telemetry and workload identification. The responder can inspect those records here; the message board and persistent changes remain outside this knowledge field. Reuse the flat lights and blank telemetry wall through the response sequence; background screens introduce no additional findings.
